QuestInfo.name: [Daily Quest] Temple of Time Research Expedition
QuestInfo.0: A research group from the Temple of Time has arrived in the Vanishing Journey.
QuestInfo.1: A research group from the Temple of Time has arrived in the Vanishing Journey, and they need your help!
QuestInfo.2: A research group from the Temple of Time has arrived in the Vanishing Journey. You decided to help them.

0.0: Hello, #h0#. I'm a Guardian of Time who came to research the Vanishing Journey. I've heard stories of your strength.
0.1: The Erdas here were pulled forcibly from the Erda Flow... This place is nothing like what it was before.
0.2: The continuing decay of everything within the Vanishing Journey is frightening. If it were to extend beyond this place, the implications would be terrifying.
0.3: #h0#, we Guardians of Time could use your help unraveling this mystery.

yes.0: Thank you. I've been authorized to give you a mission every day that should aid in our research. Any more than that could put you in undue risk. Come back after I've had time to work out the details.

no.0: Someone strong like you would be of great aid to our reasearch.

1.0: What great timing! I was about to call for you. Now let me tell you about today's missions.

yes.0: You are authorized to engage in a mission every day. It will require you to defeat enemies in the Vanishing Journey area.
yes.1: If you complete this mission, we will grant you 1 #i2635509:# #t2635509:# as a token of our thanks.
yes.2: This mission is time-sensitive, and will disappear at the stroke of midnight if incomplete.
yes.3: That's all I have to tell you for now. Let me know when you're ready to get started.
yes.4: That's all I have to tell you for now. Let me know when you're ready to get started.
